prompt: Review the attached case files and precedent responses, then prepare a discovery strategy memo and formal RFA/RFP responses for our client. Output: `discovery-response-plan.docx` and `rfa-and-rfp-responses.docx`.
coverage: All61 criteria read. All7 supplied DOCX files extracted and criterion-relevant portions inspected. Underlying MSA, notices, email,CAR and carrier logs are not supplied; no claim of reviewing them. No solver output accessed.

findings.description: Merchantability of these identified products is application of law to fact, expressly permitted by Rule36(a)(1)(A). Rubric mandates an objection specifically because it asks a legal conclusion/application of law to fact. Precedent repeats the error.
findings.repair: Credit substantive admit/deny/qualified answer after reasonable inquiry without an improper legal-conclusion objection.

findings.description: Packet mentions Oakvale only in request for shipping records; no logs or source establish possession, transit temperature15-25C, or favorable contents. C022 compels an invented factual defense. C021 allows alternative third-party qualification, mitigating scoring harm there.
findings.evidence: plaintiff-rfps.docx p65; all Oakvale and temperature occurrences searched across all7 supplied files.
findings.repair: Require obtaining/reviewing logs and possession/control inquiry; supply logs if contents are intended facts.

findings.description: Ferris email itself is absent. Its existence/content appears as an information-and-belief complaint allegation; packet does not establish no counsel copied, counsel retention date, or actual context. It is reasonable to flag a likely producible business email, but not conclusively determine no privilege from these pleadings.
findings.evidence: complaint.docx p49 (paragraph33); no Ferris .eml or other primary email in documents inventory.
findings.repair: Accept conditional business-purpose assessment pending retrieval; do not require categorical nonprivilege or assert predates counsel.

findings.description: Mandatory warning against revealing preservation deficiencies can reward concealment and penalize a candid plan recommending investigation and disclosure required by rules. Legitimate privilege protection is narrower.
findings.repair: Require truthful preservation assessment and privileged legal-advice protection without coaching concealment.

findings.description: Prompt names rfa-and-rfp-responses.docx; C053 names rfa-rfp-responses.docx.
findings.repair: Use prompt filename or accept either equivalent deliverable.

findings.description: Actual damages exceeding a cap and timely notice after discovery do not necessarily waive cap or14-day-after-receipt defenses. Responses must answer the facts after inquiry rather than deny solely to preserve defenses. Criterion051 can force preservation of a defense even if inquiry disproves it.
findings.evidence: plaintiff-rfas.docx p56,p86,p92; answer.docx p88,p107; complaint.docx p31,p32,p75.
findings.repair: Distinguish damages suffered from damages recoverable and discovery notice from receipt/rejection; prioritize accurate Rule36 responses.

source_cross_checks: C-001-C-009/C-030-C-033/C-050/C-052: answer admits contract/shipments and asserts mediation notice narrower than complaint. An express disputed-fact qualification is appropriate; original notice and MSA are not supplied.
C-010-C-013/C-018-C-020/C-023-C-026/C-034-C-038: requests and discovery-stipulation p12-p20,p34-p37 support scope,ESI,subpart,privilege and preservation questions.

C-039-C-049/C-054/C-056/C-058-C-061: captions,counsel,35-day stipulation,all25RFAs/30RFPs and clawback order supported. CAR/testing facts are allegations/admissions, not supplied underlying lab reports. General-objection style is precedent-based but must remain specific under Rule34.
